scriptItem.label: Copy RS Material
scriptItem.scriptCode: import importlib import rs_bridge_hou importlib.reload(rs_bridge_hou) # an update must not need a restart rs_bridge_hou.copy_selected_material()

scriptItem.label: Paste RS Material
scriptItem.scriptCode: import importlib import rs_bridge_hou importlib.reload(rs_bridge_hou) rs_bridge_hou.paste_material()

scriptItem.label: Refresh Node Inventory
scriptItem.scriptCode: import rs_bridge_hou classes = rs_bridge_hou.dump_node_classes() import hou if hou.isUIAvailable(): hou.ui.displayMessage( "Wrote %d Redshift node classes to\n%s" % (len(classes), rs_bridge_hou.CLASSES_SELF_FILE))

scriptItem.label: Version and paths...
scriptItem.scriptCode: import importlib import os import rs_bridge_hou importlib.reload(rs_bridge_hou) import hou lines = [ "RS Material Bridge", "", "Version: %s" % rs_bridge_hou.TOOL_VERSION, "Running from: %s" % os.path.dirname( os.path.abspath(rs_bridge_hou.__file__)), "Clipboard: %s" % rs_bridge_hou.CLIP_FILE, "Scene units: %s metres per unit" % rs_bridge_hou.scene_meters_per_unit(), ] warnings = [w for w in (rs_bridge_hou._staleness_warning(),) if w] rs_bridge_hou._show_report("RS Bridge -- Version", lines, warnings)
